adoption.rationale: The pinned README limits use to authorized, in-scope targets. The subdomain monitor feeds live-host URLs to a collector whose source regex captures absolute script URLs; ResolveReference preserves an absolute URL, and the collector checks only HTTP(S) plus a .js path before requesting it. This adopted candidate contract asks whether untrusted page HTML can induce a loopback request. CDN script fetching may explain cross-origin behavior, and the repository does not state a same-origin rule; local replay will contact only disposable loopback listeners and establishes reachability, not sensitive access or confirmed security impact.

contract.declared_domain: An ASCII HTML body served by a caller-supplied live-host fixture contains one absolute script URL of the form http://127.0.0.1:<ephemeral-port>/bundle.js, with a port distinct from the target origin. The formal query asks whether this concrete body belongs to the pinned scriptSrcRe search language. The exact Go collector replay separately checks whether it requests the second local listener and extracts its harmless endpoint body. This establishes code-level reachability only; it does not establish sensitive response access, impact on a production host, or reachability to other private-address classes.
contract.guarantee: HTML fetched from a live host in the scanned domain must not cause the collector to issue an HTTP request to IPv4 loopback. The pinned collector violates this boundary when scriptSrcRe accepts an absolute loopback .js URL, ResolveReference preserves it, and downloadFile fetches it.
contract.input_source: Untrusted HTML response bodies fetched by CollectEndpointsForHosts for URLs supplied by subdomainmonitor.diffJSEndpoints from the database's live subdomains for the scanned domain.

domain: COUNTEREXAMPLE FINDER: pinned scriptSrcRe accepts an absolute loopback .js URL from live-host HTML and the exact Go collector fetches it
